verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents programmatic APIs for CKS clusters and Inference, with generated gRPC/Connect/Protobuf clients. Nothing in the pack describes API version numbering, version pinning, or a deprecation/sunset policy. The 'Public Preview' label on the FOCUS API marks maturity, not versioning or a deprecation commitment, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
